_readme: Keyword queue for the n8n daily content pipeline. `type` controls what the automation is allowed to do: 'remix' = curate/filter products already verified in the site's picks arrays (safe to fully automate — no new specs/images/ASINs introduced). 'educational' = general electronics concepts/how-to/troubleshooting, not tied to an unverified product claim (safe to automate, still passes plagiarism + line-by-line QA). 'new-product' = requires a product NOT currently in any picks array — automation must NOT draft these; it should flag them to the research queue for a human (or a separate, slower, human-supervised research pass) to verify specs/ASIN/image before any page is written, per the site's no-fabrication standard. status starts 'pending' for all; the n8n workflow updates it to 'queued' when picked for a run, and 'published' once the PR merges.
